title: rungia parviflora var. pectinata
intro: Rungia parviflora var. pectinata, commonly known as 'Rungia', is a plant species belonging to the Lamiaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Rungia parviflora var. pectinata include wound healing, pain relief, and the treatment of respiratory infections, such as bronchitis and coughs. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and are responsible for its potential health benefits.
